scripts.generate: npm run generate:models && npm run generate:hub-client && npm run postgenerate
scripts.generate:models: hub-generator generate -g hub-module -i ./parameters.yml -o generated/ --global-property models,supportingFiles=index.ts && rm -f ./generated/api/index.ts
scripts.postgenerate: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='generated/inversify.config.ts';if(!fs.existsSync(f)){process.exit(0);}let s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const orig=\"import { IllegalArgumentError, HubConnectionProfile as RemoteHubConnectionProfile } from '@zerobias-org/types-core-js';\";const patched=\"import { IllegalArgumentError } from '@zerobias-org/types-core-js';\\nimport { HubConnectionProfile as RemoteHubConnectionProfile } from '@auditmation/hub-core';\";if(s.includes(orig)){s=s.replace(orig,patched);fs.writeFileSync(f,s);console.log('postgenerate: patched HubConnectionProfile import in '+f);}else if(s.includes(\"from '@auditmation/hub-core'\")){console.log('postgenerate: patch already applied');}else{console.error('postgenerate: WARNING - could not find canonical import line in '+f);process.exit(0);}"
